items.fact: BMW Group deliveries in China fell 12.5% in 2025, while Europe grew 7.3% and the Americas grew 5.6%.
items.consideration: Check China-specific demand, pricing and study evidence before claiming a global requirement or ranking.
items.limitation: Company-wide regional deliveries do not measure demand for a G60 feature. The supplied feedback has no China verbatims.

items.fact: Group revenue fell 6.3% to EUR 133.453 billion; Automotive EBIT margin was 5.3%, down from 6.3%; Automotive free cash flow fell to EUR 3.240 billion from EUR 4.852 billion.
items.consideration: Request scoped cost, price, adoption and cash-flow estimates before treating a proposed update as a business case.
items.limitation: Group and segment totals cannot establish the profitability of an individual feature. Free cash flow appears on report page 72.

items.fact: Tariffs reduced the 2025 Automotive EBIT margin by approximately 1.5 percentage points. BMW's report expected approximately 1.25 points of tariff impact in 2026 and guided to a 4-6% Automotive EBIT margin.
items.consideration: Stress-test market, sourcing and price assumptions; recheck the dated 2026 outlook before using it in a current decision.
items.limitation: The 2026 outlook is a forecast made when the 2025 report was prepared, not a current result or a feature-level cost estimate. The 2025 tariff figure appears on report page 70.

items.fact: Battery-electric vehicles were 17.9% of 2025 deliveries (442,059 units), up 3.6% in units; electrified BEV plus PHEV deliveries rose 8.2% to 642,071.
items.consideration: For electric-vehicle requirements, assess battery-electric and plug-in-hybrid applicability separately and test fit with the NEUE KLASSE launch plan.
items.limitation: Portfolio delivery mix does not quantify customer demand for a specific charging or software change.

items.fact: BMW reported 118.7 million tonnes of targeted Scope 3 CO2e emissions in 2025 and forecast a slight increase for 2026.
items.consideration: For energy and charging proposals, check lifecycle and use-phase effects against a reviewed vehicle-specific method.
items.limitation: The report's targeted Scope 3 measure covers specified categories and depends partly on vehicle-use assumptions; it is not a feature-level emissions estimate. The 2025 figure appears on report page 68.
